blocks.source: テイルズオブヴェスペリア
blocks.translation: Tales of Vesperia

blocks.source: ＸＢＯＸ３６０からの移植。移植とは言ったものの、ＰＳ３版の方が仲間キャラクターの追加を初めとして、色々と要素が追加されているので、ＰＳ３を持っているならば、こちらを選んでおけば間違いない。（というかＸＢＯＸ３６０版は未完成版という噂がちらほら・・・）
blocks.translation: A port from the XBOX 360. Although I call it a port, the PS3 version adds various elements, including additional party characters, so if you own a PS3, you can't go wrong with choosing that version. (In fact, there are rumors here and there that the XBOX 360 version is unfinished...)

blocks.source: 質量／物語
blocks.translation: Content / Story

blocks.source: 文章量とボイスの量はテイルズシリーズの中でも最大レベル。今の時代は世界中を巡る様な王道RPGが少なくなってしまったが、このシリーズは今でも古き良き時代のRPGの面影を残しているのが嬉しいところだ。
blocks.translation: The amount of text and voice acting is among the largest in the Tales series. Traditional RPGs that take you around the world have become scarce these days, but it's nice that this series still retains the atmosphere of RPGs from the good old days.

blocks.source: 本編、サブイベント共に、豊富で個性豊かなキャラクター達が話を盛り上げる。同じ開発チームの前作アビスと比べても、パーティメンバー達は負けずに魅力的。特に主人公のユーリが大人なので、他のシリーズ作品の様に子供っぽい主人公の言動にイライラさせられる様なこともないはず。
blocks.translation: Both the main story and side events are enlivened by a wealth of distinctive, richly characterized characters. Even compared with Abyss, the previous game by the same development team, the party members are just as appealing. In particular, since the protagonist Yuri is an adult, you shouldn't find yourself irritated by childish words and actions from the protagonist, as in some other games in the series.

blocks.source: 不満点としてはアビスの六神将の様に、何度も主人公達の前に立ち塞がる様な印象強い敵キャラクターが少ないことが挙げられる。イエガー、ゴーシュ＆ドロワット、ティソン、ナンなどＯＰアニメに出てくるキャラはもっと出番が欲しかった。ゴーシュ＆ドロワットに至っては、結局サブイベントでしか戦闘が無い。
blocks.translation: One criticism is that there are few memorable enemy characters who repeatedly stand in the protagonists' way, like the Six God-Generals in Abyss. I wish characters such as Yeager, Gauche and Droite, Tison, and Nan, who appear in the opening animation, had had more screen time. As for Gauche and Droite, you ultimately only fight them during a side event.

blocks.source: アビスの時も思ったが、エンディングをもっと長くして欲しいところだ。あれだけ濃い話なのに、アニメーション＋イラスト＆スタッフロールだけで、片付けてしまうのは実にもったいない。
blocks.translation: I felt the same way about Abyss, but I wish the ending were longer. Even though the story is so substantial, it's a real shame to wrap it up with just animation, illustrations, and the staff roll.

blocks.source: システム
blocks.translation: System

blocks.source: 基本的なシステムはアビスと大きく変わることが無い。３Ｄフィールドを自在に動くことができるアクション性の強い戦闘システムが前作と同じ特徴で、前作経験者ならば、目新しさは無いが、安定した面白さがある。
blocks.translation: The basic system hasn't changed much from Abyss. Its signature feature, shared with the previous game, is an action-oriented battle system that lets you move freely around 3D fields. For those who played the previous game, it offers nothing particularly new, but it is consistently fun.

blocks.source: 今作、独自の特徴としては武器を装備して戦うことによって、技能を習得できるスキルシステムが第一に上げられる。とはいえ、ＦＦ９に酷似しておりそれほど目新しいものでもない。
blocks.translation: The main distinctive feature of this game is its skill system, which lets you learn skills by equipping weapons and fighting with them. That said, it closely resembles FF9, so it isn't especially novel.

blocks.source: バランス／快適性
blocks.translation: Balance / Comfort

blocks.source: 初期段階では難易度は三段階から選択できる。とりあえず、僕はノーマルでプレイしたが、難しすぎず簡単すぎず、そこそこの難易度だと感じた。ただ、序盤の犬型のボスがシナリオ上どうでもいい割に妙に強いのはどうかと思った。裏ボスを除いて、一番苦戦したほどである。
blocks.translation: At the beginning, you can choose from three difficulty levels. I played on Normal, and found it reasonably challenging—not too difficult, but not too easy either. However, I thought it was odd that the dog-like boss early in the game was unusually strong despite being unimportant to the scenario. Aside from the secret boss, it gave me the most trouble.

blocks.source: ダンジョンは過度に面倒なものは無く長さや仕掛けの難しさなども丁度いい具合である。
blocks.translation: The dungeons aren't excessively tedious, and their length and puzzle difficulty are just right.

blocks.source: アビスと同様、仲間キャラクターは戦闘でも個性的で、操作していて楽しめる。主人公のユーリにこだわらず、色々と使ってみると面白いだろう。
blocks.translation: As in Abyss, the party characters each have distinctive qualities in battle and are fun to control. Rather than sticking with the protagonist Yuri, you may enjoy trying out the various characters.

blocks.source: 毎回、このシリーズでは気になるのだが、今回も武器、スキル、サブイベントなどが多すぎる。多くのスキルを覚えさせるためには、スキルを習得しつくした武器を次々と取り替えていく必要があるのだが、最終的にパーティが９人ともなると、武器の交換が毎回の戦闘ごとに発生する勢いなので、面倒だと感じた。
blocks.translation: As is often the case with this series, I had the same concern this time: there are too many weapons, skills, and side events. To learn many skills, you have to keep replacing weapons after mastering the skills attached to them. Once the party eventually grows to nine members, weapons need to be swapped so frequently that it feels like you have to do it after every battle, which I found tedious.

blocks.source: また、効果があまり実感できないスキルも多く、必要なスキルを探すのが面倒だ。武器とそれに付属するスキルの数は必要なものに限定し、半分程度に絞った方が良かったのではないだろうか？ その方が、開発時間とかも削減できてお得だと思う。（調べてみたら、なんと！武器だけで５００種類近くもあるようだ。ＳＦＣのＲＰＧなんて、アイテム全体で２５０程度なんて作品も珍しくないのに・・・）
blocks.translation: There are also many skills whose effects are difficult to notice, making it tedious to search for the ones you need. Wouldn't it have been better to limit the number of weapons and their associated skills to the essentials, reducing them by about half? That would have cut development time as well, which seems like a win-win. (When I looked into it, I was shocked to find that there are apparently nearly 500 weapons alone. It's not unusual for an SFC RPG to have only around 250 items in total...)

blocks.source: サブイベントについては、攻略情報をみないと条件が分からないようなものが非常に多い。この作品を十分に楽しむためには、必要なイベントも少なくないとも思うのだが……。また、ラストダンジョン突入前などの終盤以降にしか、発生しないサブイベントが多いのは困りもの。（もっと中盤から色々できても良いはず。）
blocks.translation: There are an enormous number of side events whose conditions are impossible to determine without consulting a walkthrough. I feel that quite a few of these events are necessary to fully enjoy the game, though.... It's also problematic that many side events only become available late in the game, such as after reaching the point just before entering the final dungeon. (You should be able to do more of this from the middle of the game onward.)

blocks.source: 前作アビスの最大の問題点であったロード時間は大幅に短縮されている。１マップが広いため、ロード回数自体もかなり減っている。
blocks.translation: The loading times, which were the biggest problem in the previous game, Abyss, have been greatly reduced. Since each map is large, the number of loading screens has also decreased considerably.

blocks.source: 少し気になったのはシンボルエンカウント制にしては、狭い道が多く敵と接触しやすい点。最も、戦闘テンポは非常に良いので、そこまで気にならないし、ホーリーボトルを使えば、敵が寄って来なくなるので、快適になる。
blocks.translation: One thing that bothered me slightly is that, despite using symbol encounters, there are many narrow paths where it's easy to run into enemies. Still, the battles have an excellent tempo, so it isn't that bothersome, and using Holy Bottles keeps enemies from approaching, making exploration more comfortable.

blocks.source: 美術
blocks.translation: Art

blocks.source: 秘奥義など、戦闘面の演出はとても派手で、見た目にも楽しい。見た目の派手さとテンポの両立もしっかりできている。
blocks.translation: The battle effects, including the Mystic Artes, are extremely flashy and fun to watch. The game also does a good job of balancing visual spectacle with pacing.

blocks.source: 前作同様、サブイベントや店などで手に入れた称号やアタッチメントを変更することによって、キャラクターの姿を変更することができる。（２週目ではシリアスなシーンでお馬鹿な格好をさせてみたり……）
blocks.translation: As in the previous game, you can change the characters' appearances by switching the titles and attachments obtained from side events, shops, and elsewhere. (On a second playthrough, you can dress them in ridiculous outfits during serious scenes...)

blocks.source: 音楽
blocks.translation: Music

blocks.source: 主旋律のはっきりしない上に、メリハリが弱い曲が多く、全体的に印象が薄い。特にラスボス戦は形態毎に曲が変わるのだけど、変化に乏しくもったいない感じ。戦闘曲は数多くあるのに、気に入ったのはフレン戦の１曲だけだった。ただ、重要な場面で、主題歌の「鐘を鳴らして」のオーケストラアレンジを流す演出はベタながらもグッと来るものがある。
blocks.translation: Many of the songs lack a clear main melody and have weak contrasts, leaving a generally faint impression. In particular, the music changes with each form during the final boss battle, but the variations are so slight that it feels like a wasted opportunity. Despite the large number of battle themes, the only one I really liked was the theme for the battle against Flynn. Still, the direction of playing an orchestral arrangement of the theme song, "Ring a Bell," during important scenes is rather predictable, but it still has a powerful impact.

blocks.source: まとめ
blocks.translation: Conclusion

blocks.source: 上の方には細かい欠点を色々と書いているが、ストーリー性、ゲーム性の他、その他おまけ要素も充実している上にロードが長いなどの致命的な欠点もない。「あちらを立てればこちらが立たず」の作品が多いテイルズシリーズの中では、最もお勧めの作品と言っていいのではないだろうか？
blocks.translation: I've listed various minor flaws above, but in addition to its story and gameplay, the game is packed with bonus content, and it has no fatal flaws such as excessively long loading times. Among the many Tales games where improving one aspect means compromising another, this may well be the one I recommend most.

blocks.source: しかし、何でもかんでも詰め込みすぎな気はするので、そろそろ、このシリーズはスリム化を覚えた方が良いと思う。これだけ、贅肉だらけでも、ＤＱやＦＦより、ずっと開発費用が少ないらしいと言うのはちょっと不思議である。
blocks.translation: However, I do feel that the game tries to cram in too much of everything, so I think this series should learn to slim down soon. It's a little puzzling that, despite being so bloated, it apparently costs far less to develop than DQ or FF.
